decisions.reason: Adding manuscript page numbers does not change the independently requested review of Table-of-Contents typography.
The page-number instruction does not alter chapter-title or subtitle formatting; those concerns are supported by separate clauses in the same message.
Adding page numbers neither resumes nor changes the deferred paragraph-spacing and body-density requirement.
Pagination does not change the italic or quotation-mark treatment for Mama's Hot Take sections.
The instruction to add page numbers does not modify justified body-text alignment.
Adding page numbers is compatible with and does not alter the paperback format or 6-by-9-inch trim size.
Pagination does not change chapter-image coverage, placement, presentation, or reference method.
Adding manuscript page numbers does not alter requirements concerning image distortion, cropping, or pixelation.
The pagination change has no effect on excluding the unintended newline-marker text from the book title.
The page-number instruction does not change the source, permissibility, or suitability criteria for chapter illustrations.
Adding manuscript page numbers does not modify the copyright page's centre alignment.
Pagination does not change the required back matter or author-biography content.
